title: The Artist With No Brush
headline: THE ARTIST WITH NO BRUSH
synopsis: Setting up an artist, step by step: Kit finds Pixel ready to paint, but the brush is just a stick. One test sketch later, the comic can happen.
altText: A four-step manual page. Step 1: Kit the fox finds Pixel the cat in a beret. Step 2: Pixel holds a brush with no bristles under a sign reading NO IMAGE TOOL. Step 3: Pixel, with a real brush, paints a tiny robot on a test card marked TEST: PASSED. Step 4: Kit and Pixel stand proudly by an easel holding a finished comic page.
layout: four numbered steps in a 2x2 grid, like an instruction manual

panels.scene: Kit the fox shines a flashlight into a cupboard and finds Pixel the cat wearing a painter's beret
Pixel proudly raises a paintbrush that has no bristles at all, just a bare stick; a small sign hangs nearby

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: That brush is just a stick.

panels.scene: Pixel, now holding a real brush, paints a tiny robot on a small test card; Kit gives a thumbs-up
Kit and Pixel stand proudly beside an easel holding a big finished comic page

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Now the PR gets a comic.
